meal.title: Printing text with printf in C
meal.objective: Use printf to display text on the console

voice.script: What if you could make the computer talk? How do you show words on the screen? In C, the function called printf lets you send text to the console. A function is a reusable piece of code you can call by name. The word printf stands for print formatted, meaning it can insert values into a template. The template is a string that may contain format specifiers, like %d for a whole number. Here we call printf with a simple string: Hello, world! When the program runs, that text appears on the screen. That's all it does.
